This video was made possible thanks to everyone on the Simple History Patreon: https://www.patreon.com/simplehistory

Built to defend Britain from German aircraft during World War II, the strange Maunsell sea forts took on a life of their own after the war. From pirate radio stations to the self-declared Principality of Sealand, discover how these bizarre offshore fortresses went from wartime defenses to an unlikely micronation.
